en.askTitle: Put in your own income, savings and target area and get the same first-home budget
en.runTitle: Greater Manchester first-time buyers: £72,000 combined income, £38,000 saved

fields.label: Debts and monthly spending
fields.placeholder: e.g. no debts, about £1,800 a month on bills and living costs

fields.label: Lifetime ISA status and first-payment date
fields.placeholder: e.g. no Lifetime ISA yet, first payment in December 2026

en.template: Plan my first-home budget in {area} for {date}, with {income}, {savings}, {debts}, {reserve}, {property} and {lisa}; show upfront costs, monthly payments, a higher-rate check and next steps.

phases.title: Check public lending criteria, mortgage products, taxes and local price evidence
phases.note: Lender income rules, current rates, Stamp Duty and the Lifetime ISA
phases.judgment: It tested the Lifetime ISA against the couple’s timeline and gave a plain answer: a newly funded Lifetime ISA would not meet the 12-month requirement by September 2027.

phases.title: Build the editable affordability workbook and the buying guide
phases.note: Deposit options, upfront costs, monthly payments and a month-by-month plan
phases.judgment: It labelled exactly what its area figures are: official district averages for August 2026 (released 21 October), stated plainly as not two-bedroom asking prices.

phases.title: Recalculate and check the final files, then hand over
phases.judgment: The workbook was recalculated before delivery: 417 formulas, zero errors.

workers: Researched dated price evidence for five Greater Manchester districts and the steps from mortgage approval to completion, and wrote the area guide

zh.askTitle: 填入你自己的收入、存款和目标区域，得到同样的首套房预算
zh.runTitle: 大曼彻斯特首次购房者：夫妻税前合计 72,000 英镑，存款 38,000 英镑

fields.label: 家庭税前及税后收入
fields.value: 夫妻税前合计 72,000 英镑，两人都有工作

fields.label: 债务和每月开支
fields.placeholder: 例如：没有债务，每月生活和账单约 1,800 英镑

fields.label: 要保留的现金
fields.placeholder: 例如：交割后保留 6,000 英镑

fields.label: Lifetime ISA 状态及首次存款日期
fields.placeholder: 例如：还没有 Lifetime ISA，计划 2026 年 12 月首次存入

zh.template: 请帮我规划在{area}、{date}前买首套房的预算：家庭税前及税后收入{income}、存款{savings}、债务和每月开支{debts}、要保留的现金{reserve}、房价及产权{property}、Lifetime ISA 状态及首次存款日期{lisa}；列出前期费用、月供、利率上升后的负担和下一步。

phases.title: 核对公开的贷款标准、房贷产品、税费和本地房价依据
phases.note: 银行的收入倍数规则、当前利率、印花税和 Lifetime ISA
phases.judgment: 它把 Lifetime ISA 放进这对夫妻的时间表里核对，并给了明确的答案：新开立并存入的 Lifetime ISA，到 2027 年 9 月还不满 12 个月的要求。

phases.title: 制作可编辑的购房能力表格和购房指南
phases.note: 首付方案、前期费用、月供和逐月计划
phases.judgment: 它写明了区域数字到底是什么：2026 年 8 月的官方区级均价（10 月 21 日发布），并明确标注“不是两居室挂牌价”。

phases.title: 重新计算并核对最终文件，然后交付
phases.judgment: 交付前把表格重新计算了一遍：417 个公式，零错误。

workers: 查大曼彻斯特五个区带日期的房价证据，以及从获批贷款到交割的各个步骤，并写成区域指南
